results.title: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl

But when a peaceful exchange ends in the total annihilation of the U.S. Congress, military men call for a full-scale nuclear retaliation.

Among them is the cocksure A.J. who Harry thinks isn't good enough for his daughter, until the mission proves otherwise.
